backend/main.mo: Main backend actor with user profile management (including customPropFirms field), account CRUD operations, payout tracking, expense management, and authorization/blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old UserProfile type (without customPropFirms) to new UserProfile type (with empty customPropFirms array) for backward compatibility.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: live search in prop firm dropdown, custom prop firm addition, backend/localStorage storage for custom firms, dropdown scrolling fix, and account submission error diagnosis.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities with focus on dark navy/teal theming, dashboard layout, and account/prop firm management features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for background, foreground, cards, borders, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script import for the React application titled 'Propfolio'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing, dashboard pages, admin panel, and public pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with fade-in animations and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AddAccountDialog: Dialog component for adding accounts with live search filtering across 55+ prop firms, custom prop firm addition with inline form, merged firm list from multiple sources (default/backend/localStorage), visual badges for custom firms, and comprehensive error handling.
Dialog component for adding new payouts with form fields for prop firm, account, amount, currency, date, and file uploads (invoice and certificate). Validates file types/sizes, converts files to ExternalBlob, and submits via useAddPayout hook.
frontend/src/components/AdminProtectedRo: Protected route wrapper that checks for admin authentication via localStorage session data. Displays loading spinner during auth check and redirects to /admin/login if not authenticated.
Main dashboard layout with sidebar, header (PropFirmTicker and LoginButton), and outlet for nested routes. Shows login prompt if unauthenticated and ProfileSetupModal if user profile is missing.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with four-column grid layout containing product links, legal links, social media icons, and copyright/attribution text including caffeine.ai credit.
frontend/src/components/LoadingSpinner.t: Reusable loading spinner component using Loader2 icon with configurable size (sm/md/lg) and custom className support.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that toggles between login/logout states using Internet Identity. Handles authentication flow, clears query cache on logout, and displays loading state during login.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name and email. Cannot be dismissed and submits UserProfile data via useSaveCallerUserProfile hook.
frontend/src/components/PropFirmTicker.t: Horizontal scrolling ticker displaying prop firm names from PROP_FIRMS constant. Uses CSS animation to create infinite scroll effect with duplicated content.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Navigation sidebar with menu items for all dashboard sections (Dashboard, Payouts, Accounts, Expenses, etc.). Highlights active route and includes Propfolio logo/branding at top.
frontend/src/components/SkeletonCard.tsx: Loading skeleton component with four variants (metric, account, payout, default) that display animated placeholder content matching different card layouts.
frontend/src/constants/propFirms.ts: Exports a sorted array of 56 prop firm names as a constant PROP_FIRMS.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, initializing access control with an admin token from URL params and invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddAccount.ts: React mutation hook for adding a trading account with validation (name, type, balance, currency) and automatic query invalidation on success.
React mutation hook that adds a custom prop firm to the backend and localStorage, then invalidates the user profile query.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddPayout.ts: React mutation hook for adding a payout record that invalidates the payouts query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoRates.ts: React query hook that fetches cryptocurrency prices (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC) in USD/EUR/GBP from CoinGecko API with 1-minute refetch interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useExchangeRates.ts: React query hook that fetches fiat currency exchange rates from exchangerate-api.com with 1-minute refetch interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAccounts.ts: React query hook that fetches all trading accounts from the backend actor when available.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend with loading state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetPayouts.ts: React query hook that fetches all payout records from the backend actor when available.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React mutation hook that saves the user profile to the backend and updates the local query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom dark navy/teal theme using OKLCH color space, defining CSS variables for UI components and global animations (shimmer, fadeIn, slideUp, scaleIn).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminAffiliateW: Admin page for managing affiliate withdrawal requests with a placeholder indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDisputes.t: Admin page for viewing and managing user disputes with a placeholder for future implementation.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page with username/password form, mock authentication (admin/admin123), and session storage for admin access.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOffers.tsx: Admin page for managing discount offers with a placeholder indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPageManage: Admin interface for controlling visibility and order of 15 dashboard pages using toggles and drag handles with save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Main admin dashboard that displays a grid of navigation cards for all admin sections (theme, pages, pricing, payments, prop firms, offers, reviews, disputes, products, users, subscriptions, affiliate withdrawals). Includes admin session management with username display and logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPaymentGat: Payment gateway configuration page with tabs for Stripe, Razorpay, Coinbase, and NOWPayments. Allows enabling/disabling gateways and securely managing API keys with show/hide toggles and test connection functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPayments.t: Payment transactions management page displaying a filterable table of all transactions with status, gateway, date, user, and amount. Includes filters for status, gateway, and date range, plus CSV/PDF export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPricingSet: Subscription pricing configuration page allowing admins to set amount, currency, billing interval, and manage a list of subscription features with add/remove functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Placeholder admin page for managing shop products with a 'coming soon' message.
Placeholder admin page for managing prop firms with a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminReviews.ts: Placeholder admin page for moderating user reviews with a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSubscripti: Placeholder admin page for viewing and managing user subscriptions with a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminThemeSetti: Admin page for customizing application theme settings including mode (light/dark), primary color, and accent color with save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page for user management that displays a placeholder message indicating the functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Accounts.ts: Dashboard page for managing prop firm accounts, displaying account cards with balance information and an add account dialog.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Affiliate.t: Affiliate program page showing earnings metrics (total, pending, redeemable) and a referral link with copy functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Compounding: Compounding calculator page with inputs for starting capital, return rate, frequency, and duration that generates period-by-period growth projections in a table.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardOv: Main dashboard overview displaying financial metrics cards (payouts, profit, expenses, tax) with animated hover effects and trend indicators.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DiscountOff: Page for displaying exclusive prop firm promotional offers, currently showing a placeholder for no available offers.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Exchange.ts: Exchange converter page with tabs for FX and crypto conversions, using live rates from custom hooks to calculate real-time currency conversions.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Expenses.ts: Dashboard page for tracking business and personal expenses with placeholder cards showing $0 totals and an empty recent expenses list.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Giveaways.t: Dashboard page displaying a 'Coming Soon' placeholder for exclusive prop firm account giveaways feature.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/IncomeTaxCa: Dashboard page with a placeholder for an income tax calculator with quarterly reminders feature.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/P2PExchange: Dashboard page showing a 'Coming Soon' placeholder for peer-to-peer cryptocurrency exchange functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Payouts.tsx: Dashboard page displaying prop firm payouts with cards showing amount, date, account details, and buttons to view invoices and certificates; includes add payout dialog and certificate modal viewer.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ReviewsDisp: Dashboard page with tabs for writing reviews and raising disputes about prop firms, currently showing empty states with add buttons.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Settings.ts: Dashboard settings page with a placeholder for profile settings and preferences management.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TaxAuditRep: Dashboard page for generating audit-ready tax reports with PDF export functionality, currently showing a placeholder for tax summary.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Tools.tsx: Dashboard page providing five trading calculators (risk, margin, P/L, lot size, swap) with input forms and calculation logic for forex trading.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TradingOver: Dashboard page displaying trading analytics with metric cards (total trades, win rate, profit factor, Sharpe ratio) and an equity curve placeholder.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TradingTool: Dashboard page for a trading tools shop showing an empty state placeholder for professional trading software products.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page component showcasing 12 product features (payout tracking, analytics, tax calculator, etc.) with hero section, header navigation, and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry payment or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Displays a success message after payment completion with a green checkmark icon and a button to navigate to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Renders the privacy policy page with sections covering information collection, usage, sharing, security, user rights, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/RefundPolicy.tsx: Displays the refund policy page detailing the 30-day money-back guarantee, eligibility criteria, request process, and processing times.
frontend/src/pages/Subscribe.tsx: Shows the subscription pricing page with a $75/year Professional Trader Suite plan listing 12 features and a subscribe button.
frontend/src/utils/customPropFirmsStorag: Utility module for managing custom prop firm names in localStorage with functions to save, retrieve, clear, and check for duplicates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including color palette with CSS variables, animations (fade-in, slide-up, scale-in, shimmer), custom shadows, Inter font family, and plugins for animations, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state document (v27) for Propfolio, a prop trading management platform, detailing architectural decisions (Internet Identity auth, manual data entry, 55+ predefined firms), known issues (email verification unavailable, sidebar visibility, calculator bugs), and extensive existing features including authentication, dashboard navigation, prop firm management, payout tracking, tax calculations, and admin systems.
